summary: to_json parameters: allow_nan, check_circular, ensure_ascii, indent, preprocess_unsafe, separators, skipkeys, sort_keys and vault_to_text.
questions: How do I keep non-ASCII characters unescaped in to_json?
How do I sort keys in JSON output?
How do I indent JSON output from to_json?
What happens to vaulted values in to_json?

answer_card.title: to_json parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `allow_nan` (default true): emit `NaN`/`Infinity`; false makes them an error
- `check_circular` (default true)
- `ensure_ascii` (default true): escape non-ASCII
- `indent` (default 0)
- `preprocess_unsafe` (default true, 2.9+)
- `separators` (default `[", ", ": "]`)
- `skipkeys` (default false): skip non-basic keys
- `sort_keys` (default false)
- `vault_to_text` (default true, 2.9+): unvault vaulted values
